Only factual item ID, game value, alchemy amounts, base ID and tradeability
are distributed. The upstream community dataset is not proof of alchability:
explicit No flags from archived OSRS Wiki item infoboxes override its payouts.
Notes inherit their original item's prohibition, including the inactive Bowfa.
ALCHEMY-FACTS-AUDIT-V31.json records the applied facts with revision links.
No icons, article prose or market prices copied into this data file.
Native cache27,359records were independently decoded without custom client
overrides and each record end was validated.25,921records overlap the historical
data. Notes use base-item payouts; bank placeholders and bought templates
are rejected. Nine beta IDs25484..25492use their native value1000instead of
stale inherited data. Separate from this game's custom shop prices.
Current category names were used only to discover candidate pages. Every
applied Wiki flag comes from a revision before2023; no current gameplay flag
is imported. Historical removed hist-prefixed IDs are deliberately excluded.
This cross-check does not certify every item, quest or utility spell as complete.
No live Grand Exchange feed is used by this offline world. Warning controls
explicitly display local valuations; payouts never use those shop prices.
